_note: Encounters between the major areas (T15, crates/core/src/wanderers.rs). Each way runs between two places of data/places.json, along the road, a trail, or in the open in a straight line. A way is measured only where it is clear of the keep distances below (the village's 700 m band is the roadside part's, T12); on what is left, a slot falls every_m or less (the run cut into equal parts, each slot moved up to jitter_m either way by the seed), and each slot takes one encounter. A run of least_m or more has one slot at least. The kinds are filled in the order listed: each takes a count from its range by the seed and the slots it fits, chosen by the seed; the kind with no count fills the rest. Distances in metres, times in seconds. Foes are orc, bandit, or lookout (a bandit wearing the lookout's look). What a kind leaves are consumables only (CW-6): coins, rocks, knives, bandages.
_wake_m: an encounter stands when the player comes this near its anchor, and is parked past park_m; most_near caps the standing foes within wake_m of the player, every hostile foe counted

keep._note: where nothing is placed: this far from the village centre, the camp's centre, any other place's centre, a waystone, the trainer or the traveller, and the merchant's beat along the road
keep._glade_m: M7 forest (T19): this far past the edge of each of the forest's clearings (data/places.json, forest.glades), whose own foes are the kinds on 'glade' below

live._note: while it runs: a foe this near the village centre, or the trainer, the traveller or the merchant's cart, stops fighting and goes back

_least_m: a run this long or longer has one slot at least
_sight_m: a roaming orc or a patrol sees the player this far; a lookout lookout_m; anyone at a held site notices at notice_m; an ambush springs at spring_m; any of them is up once one is hurt, and calms once the player is calm_m from all

kinds.name: ambush
kinds._cover_m: behind the tree or big rock nearest the slot, this far from the trail, within along_m of the slot

kinds.name: patrol

kinds.name: orc_fire
kinds._side_m: off the way to one side, on ground clear of trees and rocks within clear_m and level within flat_cm
kinds._stand: metres right and toward the way from the site's centre
